column1: SPEC — AR, Invoicing, Collections & Revenue Recognition
All entities | Auto-create from OS sales | Reminders | Paid webhook → Commission + Cash Forecast | ASC 606
1. INVOICE LIFECYCLE
Draft → Approved → Sent → Viewed → Partial → Paid → Overdue / Void / Written Off
Trigger: Sale created → upsert Customer → invoice lines → due date → attach packet (entity defaults: Wire + I-9 + any Required docs; + customer defaults) → send + reminders.
2. CORE FIELDS (Invoice Header)
Invoice # | Entity | Customer ID | Invoice Date | Due Date | Currency | Status | Subtotal | Tax | Total | Amount Paid | Balance | Source System ID | Placement/Subscription Ref
3. LINE ITEMS
SKU | Description | Qty | Rate | Amount | Revenue Account | Rev Rec Method | Commissionable flag | Linked Person/Placement
4. REMINDERS & COLLECTIONS
• Configurable cadence: e.g. -3 days, Due date, +7, +14, +30 (email/SMS)
• Escalation rules and collections queue
• AR Aging buckets: Current | 1-30 | 31-60 | 61-90 | 90+
5. PAID WEBHOOK / CALLBACK (Critical)
When status = Paid (full or final partial):
1. Update AR and Cash (Operating 1000 via Cash Routing)
2. Fire Commission Engine → Cr 2250 Protected Commission Liability
3. Fire Revenue Split Waterfall → allocation_ledger buckets by dept (DIR/SALES/MKT/GA/TECH/CONT/MGMT/SS/PROFIT) for actuals + hiring envelopes
4. Update Cash Forecast + Forecast bucket actuals + OS commission callback
5. Release deferred revenue per Rev Rec schedule (SaaS)
6. REVENUE RECOGNITION
Point in Time (Direct Hire) | Over Time (Contract, Fractional, Monthly HR) | Deferred/Subscription (Instant NDA SaaS) — ASC 606 compliant schedules
7. REPORTING HOOKS
AR Aging by entity/customer | Invoice register | Collections performance | Deferred revenue rollforward | Paid vs Open
Cursor implementation notes: Event-driven; idempotent webhooks; full audit trail on status changes; template per entity/revenue type.
8. INVOICE ATTACHMENTS (auto + optional)
SSOT: MD - Invoice Attachments. Every entity has Required defaults: Wiring Instructions + I-9 Packet (and any other Required=Yes rows).
On Send assembly: (1) Invoice PDF (2) Entity defaults by Sort Order (3) Customer-level defaults (4) Per-invoice extra uploads. Dedupe by hash. Block send if Required doc missing/inactive.
Per-invoice extras: user/API can attach additional files for that invoice only (SOW page, timesheet, PO copy, etc.).
Customer extras: files that go on every invoice to that client (billing addendum, special remit).
Future entities: auto-create Wire + I-9 default rows; ops uploads PDFs before first send.
Cursor: document store refs; preview attachments on invoice detail; email/PDF zip or multi-attach send. See MD - Invoice Attachments.
